title: Hurry Hurry School Morning | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful morning rhyme about getting ready for school on time, with a fun clock alarm and a search for a missing shoe.
It teaches kids to pack their bag the night before and to help each other get ready.
Sing along and enjoy a happy, busy school morning with the whole family!

Ring ring ring, the clock is loud
Wake up now, we're running late
Ding-dong, ding-dong, ding-dong-ding
Little sister jumps out of bed!
Hurry hurry, put on your shoes
Bag on your back, run run run
Tap-tap, tap-tap, tap-tap-tap
School is waiting just for us!
Where, oh where, is my shoe?
Brother looks beneath the bed
Thump, thump, thump, thump
Found it, found it, now let's go!
Hurry hurry, put on your shoes
Bag on your back, run run run
Tap-tap, tap-tap, tap-tap-tap
School is waiting just for us!
At night, little sister packs her bag
Ready, ready, pencil, book
Zip, zip, zip, zip
All set for tomorrow morning!
Hurry hurry, put on your shoes
Bag on your back, run run run
Tap-tap, tap-tap, tap-tap-tap
School is waiting just for us!
Next morning, all is ready
Amma smiles and waves goodbye
Bye-bye, bye-bye, bye-bye, bye
Right on time, right on time, hooray!
